p2p.cmd.usage.invite: §7/p2p invite <player>§r  Invite a player to share your network (they must be online)
p2p.cmd.usage.accept: §7/p2p accept [player]§r  Accept an invite (oldest if no player given)
p2p.cmd.usage.leave: §7/p2p leave <player>§r   Leave the other player's network (both directions)
p2p.cmd.usage.kick: §7/p2p kick <player>§r    Kick a player from your network (both directions, owner only)
p2p.cmd.usage.members: §7/p2p members§r        List networks and members you can see
